QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Erda Saturation
QuestInfo.1: The #bWorld's Sorrow#k is rich in Erda. When a monster is defeated, the Erda from that monster combines with the existing Erda to form an #bErda Saturation#k. In a saturated Erda environment, you'll experience a #bspecial effect#k. Use this effect to wipe out the monsters and then report to #b#p3003564##k to complete the Expedition mission.
QuestInfo.2: You made the most of the Erda Saturation and completed the Expedition mission.

default.0: Take advantage of the Erda Saturations that occur in the #bWorld's Sorrow#k.\r\n-The #bWorld's Sorrow#k is rich in Erda. Defeating a powerful monster temporarily results in an #bErda Saturation#k. During an Erda Saturation, you can take advantage of a helpful #bspecial effect#k.
